blocks.text: EXT. SESHACHALAM FOREST — DAWN
Mist rolls between ancient sandalwood trees. The forest is alive — birds, insects, rustling. Camera drifts through the canopy.
PUSHPA
(walking slowly, surveying his domain)
Ee adavi lo raja evarante... Pushpa Raj.
Pushpa runs his hand along the bark of a sandalwood tree. His eyes scan the grove — counting, assessing.
EXT. VILLAGE ROAD — DAY
Dust rises as three police vehicles barrel down a narrow village road. Villagers stop and stare.
SP BHANWAR SINGH
Pushpa Raj ki location batao. Nahi toh gaon mein ek bhi aadmi nahi bachega.
SP Bhanwar Singh steps out in full uniform. His men fan out. The villagers scatter.
VILLAGER
Saab, Pushpa anna gaon mein nahi hai. Jangal mein gaye.
EXT. TEMPLE ENTRANCE — DUSK
Oil lamps flicker at the ancient temple entrance. Srivalli stands at the threshold, wind catching her dupatta.
SRIVALLI
(turning, seeing someone approach)
Pushpa... nuvvu tirigochav.
PUSHPA
Nenu entha dooram vellina, nee daggiriki vasthanu Srivalli.
CUT TO:

blocks.text: EXT. KASI CITY — BAZAAR DISTRICT — DAY
A sprawling dystopian bazaar under the shadow of the Complex spire. Vendors hawk synthetic food. Refugees crowd narrow alleys. Holographic bounty boards flicker overhead.
BHAIRAVA
Oka bounty pakka ayyindi ante, Complex lo seat guarantee.
EXT. SHAMBHALA FORTRESS — WALL — DAWN
Ancient stone walls rising from dense jungle mist. Ashwatthama stands motionless atop the parapet, his staff planted beside him, surveying the valley below.
ASHWATTHAMA
(ancient, weary, resolute)
Veyyi samvatsaralu kaadu... naaku time anedhi ledu. Dharma maatrame undi.
INT. REBEL SAFEHOUSE — NIGHT
A cramped underground chamber. Rebel fighters huddle around a holographic map. Sumathi sits apart, arms wrapped around herself, staring at the floor.
SUMATHI
Naa babu ni kaapaadithe chaalu. Migithadhi mee istam.
INT. THE COMPLEX — THRONE ROOM — NIGHT
Cavernous obsidian chamber. Columns stretch into darkness above. A single beam of light falls on the throne. Supreme Yaskin sits motionless — part machine, part myth.
SUPREME YASKIN
Kalki puttithe... naa prapancham antham. Aa pillavaadini naaku kaavali.
SMASH CUT TO:

blocks.text: EXT. GOVERNMENT BUILDING — DAWN
A massive government building against the dawn sky. Flags flutter. Security guards patrol. A convoy of white Ambassador cars pulls up.
RAM NANDAN
(determined stride)
System ni change cheyyalanukuntunna. Lopalunchi.

A sealed ballot box sits on a table. Tension in the room. Officials, journalists, party workers crowd every corner.
ELECTION OFFICER
Results announce chestunnam. Silence maintain cheyandi.
RAM NANDAN
(under his breath)
Ee result tho era maaripothundi.
INT. STATE LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY — DAY
The assembly is in uproar. MLAs shout across the aisle. Ram Nandan stands at the podium, unflinching. CM Boora Narsaiah watches from the treasury bench, seething.
RAM NANDAN
Ee assembly lo nijam cheppina vaadiki chair ledu. Kaani nenu naa duty vadlanu.
CM BOORA NARSAIAH
(standing, furious)
Nuvvu IAS officer vi. Nee panilo nuvvu undu. Rajakeeyam naaku vaddu.

blocks.text: INT. HIT HEADQUARTERS — FORENSIC LAB — DAY
Sterile white walls. Evidence bags arranged on steel tables. Microscopes, UV lamps, chemical reagent bottles. SP Arjun Sarkaar enters, scanning the room.
ARJUN SARKAAR
(methodical, obsessive)
Ee case lo prathi evidence ni rendu saarlu verify cheyandi. Oka mistake ki scope ledu.
INT. HIT HEADQUARTERS — INVESTIGATION ROOM — NIGHT
A large board dominates the wall — photos of victims, maps with red pins, string connections between suspects. Arjun studies it alone, coffee going cold.
ARJUN SARKAAR
Pattern undi. Vaadu manaki kanipinchani pattern follow avuthunnadu.
EXT. MOUNTAIN HIDEOUT — TREELINE — DAWN
Snow-covered pine forest. Dawn light filters through ice-coated branches. Arjun leads a tactical team in single file through the trees, breath visible in the cold.
ARJUN SARKAAR
(whispering into radio)
Positions confirm cheyandi. Entry point South side. Vaadu loptala unnadu — vaadiki teliyakunda vellaali.
CUT TO:

blocks.text: EXT. ANCESTRAL PALACE — GATE — NIGHT
A towering Gothic palace looms against a stormy sky. Iron gates creak open on their own. Lightning illuminates gargoyle rain spouts and crumbling balustrades.
RAJA
(nervously looking up at the palace)
Property papers sign cheyyadaaniki vacchanu. Oka raatri stay cheste chaalu annaru. Easy ga...
Thunder BOOMS. Raja flinches. He squares his shoulders and walks through the gate.
INT. ANCESTRAL PALACE — PORTRAIT HALL — NIGHT
A long hall lined with oil portraits of ancestors. Moonlight streams through tall windows. Raja walks slowly, eyeing the portraits. In one ornate mirror, a figure materializes behind him.
THE GHOST
(appearing in the mirror, amused)
Naa palace ki welcome, raja gaaru. Ikkada oka raatri ante... naa conditions ki agree avvaali.
RAJA
Meeru... meeru nijam ga... bhootham aa?
INT. ANCESTRAL PALACE — GRAND BALLROOM — NIGHT
A vast ballroom in pristine vintage condition — as if frozen in time. Crystal chandeliers blaze. Period-costumed dancers fill the floor. Raja stands at the entrance, stunned.
THE GHOST
Dance cheyyandi raja gaaru. Ee palace lo celebrate cheyyani raatri undadu.
CUT TO:

projects.logline: Ojas Gambheera, a feared underworld boss who vanished a decade ago, resurfaces in Mumbai to settle unfinished blood debts.
projects.description: Ten years after vanishing into exile, gangster Ojas Gambheera (OG) returns to the Mumbai underworld to dismantle criminal baron Omi Bhau's syndicate in a stylish neo-noir bloodbath.

projects.title: HIT: The Third Case
projects.logline: Fierce cop Arjun Sarkaar is drafted into the Homicide Intervention Team's darkest cross-border serial murder investigation.
projects.description: SP Arjun Sarkaar takes charge of the HIT franchise's most brutal interstate manhunt, tracking an elusive predator whose cryptic psychological patterns push Sarkaar to the very edge of sanity.

projects.title: The Raja Saab
projects.logline: A young romantic discovers his royal ancestral estate is guarded by an eccentric ghost with a bizarre claim to his bloodline.
projects.description: Blending lavish vintage horror aesthetics with slapstick romance, The Raja Saab follows an easygoing heir navigating an eccentric royal spirit within a labyrinthine haunted palace.
